# KRN repository rules

This file is already loaded as CLAUDE.md; do not read it again. Small change: edit, run `npm run fast` once (biome --write, tsc, related tests, one verdict), commit; CI runs the rest.

- **KRN-07** When a change is ready for integration, the author MUST obtain a successful full Product aggregate `Check` from GitHub Actions (App `15368`) on the exact HEAD
- **KRN-09** When the lead works in this repository, the lead MUST follow `docs/program/lead-rules.md` for evidence, proposals, handoffs, and delivery
- **KRN-10** When an agent works in this repository, the agent MUST follow `docs/program/repository-workflow.md` for the local KRN delivery process and terminal PR closeout
- **KRN-11** When a work item is managed, the lead MUST manage task status in `tasks/<id>.json` with `krn task` (`ready`, `claim`, `release`, `close`); workers MUST NOT mutate tracker state except that a lane closes its own task record, inside its own worktree, in the PR that carries `Ticket:`; workers must receive the task id in their brief, and MUST use it in commit titles and the `Ticket:` trailer (`Refs:` while the task stays open)
- **KRN-12** When code is integrated or forwarded, the author MUST test every integration or forward against its real receiver or a verbatim capture of its output
- **KRN-13** When the lead works in this repository, the lead MUST keep context bounded: delegate reading to a subagent returning a verdict and path, pass pointers instead of file contents, verify by commands that print a verdict, run independent slices as parallel worktree lanes with background agents, and hand off at the context-gauge advisory with `krn-handoff`
- **KRN-14** When a defect is fixed, the author MUST add its regression test at the lowest layer that reproduces it
<!-- krn-agent-workflow:end -->
